subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the protagonist defined by the character sheet in <Picture 1>. The sheet provides her identity and wardrobe throughout the video.

summary:
[reference generation] Create a 10-second cinematic fantasy-action sequence featuring <Subject 1> running along a rugged mountain ridge with a brown eagle flying close beside her. The camera retreats ahead of her, then smoothly arcs into a lateral tracking view as she raises her sword overhead, brings it forward, and continues charging along the trail.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - consistently maintain the identity and wardrobe established by <Picture 1> across running poses and changing camera angles. Allow natural wind movement and physical motion in the referenced clothing.

detailed_description:
A photorealistic epic adventure sequence, 10 seconds, 16:9. A narrow, uneven mountain trail crosses a rocky ridge above a deep valley. Layered mountain peaks, steep cliffs, scattered boulders, and low shrubs stretch into the distance. Warm sunlight breaks through heavy clouds from the side and rear, illuminating drifting dust and outlining the moving subjects. Use grounded physical motion, detailed terrain, and strong cinematic depth.

[Shot 1] One continuous tracking shot without cuts.

From 0 to 2.5 seconds, begin with a frontal medium-wide view of <Subject 1> running forcefully toward the camera along the mountain path. The camera retreats at her pace, keeping her centered while revealing the valley behind. She holds a straight steel sword low in her right hand, with the blade angled away from her legs, while her left arm pumps naturally. Each footfall produces a small burst of dust and loose grit. Her stride adapts to the uneven ground with clear weight transfer and firm contact.

A large brown eagle flies close above and to screen left of her shoulder. Its broad wings alternate between powerful downstrokes, recovery strokes, and short glides. Keep the bird slightly behind her forward position, with its wings and talons clear of her body and sword.

From 2.5 to 4.5 seconds, <Subject 1> raises the sword from beside her body into a high overhead position while maintaining her running rhythm. Her right elbow lifts and extends, carrying the rigid blade upward in a coherent arc. She opens her mouth in a fierce rallying expression without prescribed words. Dust trails behind her as the eagle spreads its wings and keeps pace. The camera begins a smooth arc away from the frontal view toward her side.

From 4.5 to 6.5 seconds, she brings the sword forward from overhead, briefly holding the blade steeply upward in front of her before lowering it toward waist height. Keep this a controlled running gesture rather than an impact against an unseen opponent. Her torso leans into the charge and her left arm extends briefly for balance. The camera completes its arc into a three-quarter side view, revealing more of the rocky slope and distant ridgelines.

From 6.5 to 10 seconds, settle into a lateral tracking composition as <Subject 1> runs toward screen right. She carries the sword low and forward in her right hand, its tip clear of the trail, while her left arm resumes its running swing. The eagle remains above and slightly behind her, alternating broad wingbeats with gliding. Foreground rocks pass quickly while distant mountains shift slowly through parallax. Backlit dust streams behind her footsteps.

Finish with both subjects still moving toward screen right: the runner mid-stride, the sword held securely, and the eagle airborne above her. Maintain momentum through the final frame without stopping or introducing a new event.
